publication_time_policy.published_at: Use the WPSR release date exposed by the official weekly index combined with the release time from the official EIA WPSR schedule in America/New_York. Standard releases use the official Wednesday 10:30 a.m. Eastern schedule; non-Wednesday releases require an exact matching holiday-schedule row and its explicit release time.
publication_time_policy.available_at: Use only the first successful acquisition time of the matching WPSR summary PDF version. Never backdate availability to the scheduled release time.
publication_time_policy.ingested_at: Use acquisition time in the source adapter; the common live pipeline conservatively restamps successful records at batch completion.
publication_time_policy.revision_policy: The current WPSR summary PDF may be revised after initial publication. A newly acquired changed version keeps the report release timestamp as published_at, but its availability is never represented earlier than the actual acquisition of that version.

production_evidence_2026_09_02.official_release_time_evidence: EIA schedule states wpsrsummary.pdf is released after 10:30 a.m. Eastern on standard Wednesdays; EIA revision notice for August 26, 2026 states the full WPSR data and summary text were published at 10:30 a.m.
production_evidence_2026_09_02.revision_evidence: EIA revision notice states the August 26 summary text was corrected at 12:13 p.m.; therefore Last-Modified/PDF metadata are not accepted as original publication time.
